releaseBoundary: This is a manually pinned primary-source security baseline. It is not a live updater. Refresh checkedAt, versions, securityFixCount and reference on the day of every public Direct release. A zero securityFixCount means the official Stable post did not enumerate security fixes; it never means that the version is exempt from the minimum-version gate.
policy: New public NeAntik Direct builds must meet the latest widely deployed macOS Desktop Stable security baseline. The official October15 update lists155.0.8059.84/.85 and10 security fixes. M156 Early Stable remains a limited rollout, tracked separately. Refresh on publication day; historical provenance binds archived baseline bytes independently. A numeric baseline pass is not proof that an older Early Stable branch contains every later security fix. A different Chromium branch requires an exact source-contract-bound review of every listed security fix; public alpha does not waive this gate.
